title: google-research/paper-orchestra
lede: PaperOrchestra, from Google Cloud AI Research, chains specialised agents to turn research ideas and experiment logs into a LaTeX manuscript with a literature review and generated figures.

points: Separate agents handle the outline, literature review, section writing, refinement and plotting.
Related work is searched, prioritised and cited automatically, with a Semantic Scholar key among the inputs.
Output follows a conference LaTeX template such as CVPR 2025; new templates go in their own folder.
Writer and reflection agents can use different models, with Gemini or OpenAI keys set in a .env file.
The dataset behind its paper is not included yet, and the README notes it is not an official Google product.

points.text: A user asks whether the pipeline is meant to work only with Gemini models.
The Streamlit demo loses uploaded figures because their captions never reach figures/info.json.
